_comment: DSM anchor RP2350 OTP layout plan (spec §3). This is a DOCUMENTED PLAN, not a ready-to-burn file. The 'row_base' values are page-relative (page * 64) and MUST be confirmed free against 'picotool otp list' on the target silicon and against RP2350 datasheet §13 before any burn. secure-monitor and nonsecure-app source MUST reference these same constants. All numeric burns are one-time; a wrong value bricks the board.

mu_enrolled.purpose: 32-byte BLAKE3 digest of the canonical Non-secure app image (the exact [load_addr, load_addr+len) byte range the monitor measures).
mu_enrolled.encoding: 16 ECC rows, little-endian 16-bit halfwords of the 32-byte digest
mu_enrolled.permissions: secure-read only; non-secure read denied; debug/DMA denied

k_host_root.purpose: >=32 bytes CSPRNG entropy; the ROOT of the host signing key. NEVER derived from stpub, chip_id, public enrollment data, firmware bytes, or any reproducible label. k_host = HKDF(k_host_root, 'DSM/host-sign/v1' || device_identity || policy_id), derived only inside the monitor, kept only in Secure SRAM, zeroized after use.
k_host_root.encoding: 16 ECC rows, little-endian 16-bit halfwords of 32 random bytes
k_host_root.permissions: secure-read only; non-secure read denied; debug/DMA denied
k_host_root.written_by: provisioning (CSPRNG on the provisioning host; guard the file like a key)

policy_version.purpose: policy id + monotonic firmware/policy version metadata (rollback prevention anchor for a FUTURE update protocol; v1 has no update path).

monitor_config_digest.purpose: optional BLAKE3 digest of the monitor configuration (SAU/ACCESSCTRL plan + OTP layout) for cross-checking; optional in v1.

boot_key_fingerprint.purpose: secp256k1 public-key fingerprint of the DEDICATED MONITOR signing key (RP2350 secure boot). Produced by 'picotool seal --sign secure-monitor.elf ... monitor-otp.json'. Only the finalized monitor is signed by this key; ordinary app updates NEVER use it. Unused boot-key slots are disabled.

crit_lockdown.purpose: SECURE_BOOT_ENABLE + DEBUG_DISABLE (+ secure-debug-disable) + disable unused boot paths. HAL reads CRIT bit0=secure_boot_enabled, bit2=debug_disabled. DO LAST.
crit_lockdown.selector: CRIT register rows — read exact selectors from RP2350 datasheet §13; provisioning refuses to guess them.
crit_lockdown.written_by: manual 'picotool otp set <CRIT selector> <value>' from the reviewed plan

permissions_note: The 'secure-read only' pages (mu_enrolled, k_host_root, policy_version, monitor_config_digest) are locked via 'picotool otp permissions otp-permissions.json'. Build otp-permissions.json from the RP2350 datasheet §13 permission schema; do not guess the permission bits.
